title: Radius formula correct
description: Essential: Student correctly states or derives r1 = mv0/(eB).

title: Time t1 correct
description: Essential: Student correctly states or derives t1 = πm/(eB).

title: Time t2 correct
description: Essential: Student correctly states or derives t2 = πm/(3eB).

title: Lorentz force reasoning
description: Important: Student applies F = evB = mv0^2/r to relate force to circular motion.

title: Period calculation
description: Important: Student correctly finds the period T = 2πm/(eB) from the radius and velocity.

title: Central angle for electron 2
description: Important: Student identifies the correct central angle (60°) for electron 2's arc based on geometry (ac as midpoint of chord ab).

title: Time fraction from period
description: Important: Student correctly relates motion time to period via t = (θ/360°)T or t = (θ/(2π))T.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Student uses incorrect sign for electron charge (e as positive) in force/motion equations.

title: Geometry misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly determines the central angle for electron 2 (e.g., 90°, 120°, 180°).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Student shows unit analysis for final answers (mass, charge, B, time).
